title: Audit PR 212 UFO app, Organ Registry, Life identity, propulsion, and mobile ATM stacked lineage without importing protected effects
reason: PR 212 is stacked on held PRs 211 and 201 and adds contracts, a browser projection, policy documents, tests, indexes, compile evidence and a dedicated workflow. Its Life contract treats any constructor-supplied nonzero identifier as formal Life, permits controller actions after the registered ship becomes inactive, and relies on mutable external registry state without canonical birth or controller-acceptance proof. Its mobile ATM readiness is global rather than bound to the ship and bypasses critical-organ binding. Its propulsion model accepts caller-selected parameters, truncates nonzero sub-unit input mass to zero and has no non-relativistic delta-v guard. The safe action is an evidence-only audit. No candidate path is transplanted and all deployment, Life, controller, organ, ATM, token and chain effects remain blocked.

inventory.failed_run_disposition: Historical Responsive Product QA failure at a0be9af4 was superseded by successful Responsive, Pages and Universal runs at exact current main 90c29b44d30431c4b2c888f8878118fe1b23a0f5.
inventory.selected_runtime_defect: Life activation, heartbeat and intent authorization do not require the registered ship to remain active; the browser projection likewise allows activation without ship readiness and exposes global mobile-ATM capability in any non-retired state.
inventory.security_blocker: Caller- or constructor-supplied identity, controller, organ, ATM and propulsion facts can be treated as authoritative without canonical Life birth, controller acceptance, ship-bound capability, registry governance, bounded physics or deployed production authority.

blocking_findings: PR 212 is open, Draft, unmerged, stacked on held PR 211 and held grandparent PR 201, and diverged from exact latest main by 76 commits ahead and 242 behind.
The 13-path stacked diff adds a workflow, three contracts, a browser runtime projection, three policy/review documents, two test suites and compile evidence while rewriting two product indexes.

KAIOSUFOLife accepts an arbitrary constructor-supplied nonzero lifeId and formalLifeAssigned returns true solely because the value is nonzero; there is no canonical birth record, signature, registry proof, freshness, revocation or Human authorization.

KAIOSUFOLife onlyController checks equality against the current registry controller. Activation, heartbeat and intent do not require the ship to be active, so a deactivated ship can retain an operational Life state and continue controller-authorized actions.
Flight readiness is checked only when entering flight. Later Organ Registry or ship-readiness revocation does not automatically invalidate the stored Life state.

KAIOSUFOOrganRuntime readyForMobileATM checks only active ship, controller and a nonzero global ATM organ. It neither binds the ATM capability to that ship nor requires the critical organs used by readyForFlight and readyForCogeneration.
The browser ufo-runtime canActivate predicate ignores ship active status and organ readiness, and canUseAtm allows every non-retired state including DORMANT when a global capability flag is present.
The browser projection trusts raw formalLifeAssigned and lifeId snapshot fields without binding them, allowing inconsistent projections such as formal assignment with a zero or unrelated identifier.

KAIOSUFOPropulsionPhysics is pure but accepts caller-selected shipId, mass flows, efficiencies, allocations and exhaust parameters; no deployed engine profile, oracle, controller proof or Canon-authorized configuration binds those values.
Propulsion input mass uses integer division by 1,000,000. A nonzero sub-unit totalInputMgWad can truncate to zero energy instead of being rejected or carried with explicit precision.

The propulsion calculation checks exhaust velocity below c but has no bound ensuring computed deltaV remains non-relativistic or subluminal. Long duration or high power can produce a result greater than c despite the documents reserving relativistic flight for a future runtime.

The candidate documents describe verified Product 06 lineage even though parent PR 211 remains held for unverifiable burn provenance, arbitrary scale and authority boundaries and grandparent PR 201 remains held for token-liveness and dusting risks.
Current main records the production KUFO and KSHIP systems as NOT_DEPLOYED / FUTURE. Candidate contracts, registries, mobile ATM and Life concepts have no deployment or production-authority evidence.

The exact-head workflow is read-only and green but uses v4 actions with Node.js 20 deprecation warnings, runs only the historical branch-specific 12-test suite and does not provide current Universal, Game, Responsive, screenshot or exact-main successor evidence.
positive_findings: The propulsion contract is pure and does not itself transfer, burn, mint, deploy or mutate chain state.
Flight and cogeneration readiness require an active ship, matching controller and ship-bound critical organs at the point of readiness evaluation.
The propulsion model checks allocation conservation and exhaust velocity below c and keeps KGOD allocation as a potential rather than minting it.
The dedicated exact-head workflow used contents read permission only and its 41-contract compile plus 12 tests succeeded.
The written scale uses 1 KGEN equals 1,000 kilograms, 1 KAIOS equals 1 kilogram, 1 KUFO equals 1 gram and 1 KSHIP equals 1 milligram, matching current scale documents.
safe_successor_requirements: Resolve or explicitly supersede held parents PR 201 and PR 211 before advancing any child, then start a bounded successor from exact latest main on a non-codex branch.

Require canonical Life birth evidence with domain separation, issuer authority, subject/controller binding, freshness, revocation and explicit Human authorization; a nonzero identifier must never create formal Life status.

Require active ship status and current ship-bound critical-organ readiness for activation, heartbeat, intent and continued flight; define automatic fail-closed behavior when registry or ship readiness is revoked.
Bind mobile ATM capability to the specific ship and controller and preserve payment, custody, wallet and Mainnet effects behind separate explicit authorization.
Bind browser projections to one internally consistent authoritative snapshot and reject contradictory Life, ship, controller, organ and capability fields.

Define a Canon-authorized propulsion profile with explicit units, precision and bounded inputs; reject nonzero values that would truncate to zero and reject outputs outside the declared non-relativistic domain.
Require controller acceptance, transfer/recovery, delayed governance, quorum, revocation and deployed registry evidence before any ship, Organ or Life authority is treated as real.
Run current compiler baselines, workflow-security, Universal, Game, Responsive and screenshot suites at the exact successor head before any UI or game integration.
Do not deploy, activate Life, bind organs, enable ATM, appoint a controller, access a signer, dispatch workflows, pay, transfer, burn, mint, govern or mutate chain state as part of this audit.
